YOUR WORDS, YOUR EYES ONLY

items.title: Fernando — 3D Era Radio Tuner
items.subtitle: Radio worth stealing a car for
items.developerTagline: Radio worth stealing a car for
items.productDescription:
The dial still works.

Fernando puts the radio dial from the greatest era of open-world games back in your hands — and in your car. Every station of five games, still broadcasting, exactly the way you remember them.

This isn't a playlist app. Fernando is a faithful recreation of the original in-game radio logic, rebuilt from the ground up:

• Stations keep playing while you're tuned away. Retune an hour later and you'll land mid-song, mid-ad, mid-rant — wherever the programme actually got to.
• Real sequencing. DJ intros and outros, station idents, adverts, and talk breaks are scheduled by the same rules the games used — not shuffled.
• Gapless, authentic transitions. Songs flow through their original baked-in intros and fades. No synthetic crossfades, ever.
• The dial feels right. Tuning static, clicks, and retune sounds come from your game's own sound banks.
• CarPlay. It's a car radio. Put it in a car.

SUPPORTED TITLES

Fernando reads the radio audio directly from your own copy of:

• Grand Theft Auto III (2001) — PC and PlayStation 2
• Grand Theft Auto: Vice City (2002) — PC and PlayStation 2
• Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas (2004) — PC and PlayStation 2
• Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories (2005) — PlayStation 2
• Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories (2006) — PlayStation 2

Point Fernando at a PC installation folder — or import an archive, or an image of your own game disc — and it does the rest.

IMPORTANT

Fernando contains no music, no audio, and no game content. It is a player for files you already own: you must have your own legally obtained copy of the games listed above. Fernando does not include, download, or unlock any copyrighted material.

Fernando is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed, sponsored, or approved by Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc., or Sony Interactive Entertainment Inc. Grand Theft Auto and all related titles are trademarks of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. PlayStation is a trademark of Sony Interactive Entertainment Inc. All trademarks are the property of their respective owners.

items.title: Cadence: Tempo & BPM
items.subtitle: Music
items.tertiaryTitle:
Designed for iPhone.
Not verified for macOS.
items.productDescription:
Cadence is a music player built around one thing most players ignore: tempo.

Other speed-changer apps only let you nudge a song by a vague percentage. Cadence works in real beats per minute. Set a track to an exact BPM and see at a glance which songs already sit at the same speed — so you can line up a whole set at the pace you want. For anyone who dances, teaches, or practices to music, that's a different kind of control.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

- Work in real BPM, not percentages. Every track carries its actual tempo, so "128 BPM" tells you something useful and you can match songs by speed.

- Set the tempo your way. Tap along with the beat to set a song's original BPM, or let Cadence detect it automatically.

- Change speed on your own tracks with the pitch kept natural. Import local audio and slow it down to drill a tough passage, then bring it back up to tempo as you improve — no chipmunk vocals.

- Build playlists and sets. Group tracks for a class, a practice session, or a social, and sort by tempo to sequence songs by speed.

- Share a set. Send a playlist to another dancer and their Cadence imports it with every tempo — original and preferred — intact.

- Bring your own music. Add songs from your Apple Music library (an Apple Music subscription is required to play catalog tracks), or import audio files straight from your device.

WHO IT'S FOR

Teachers who need a song at exactly the right pace for a class. Dancers who want to practice below tempo before taking it up to speed. Anyone who's ever wondered whether two songs are actually danceable at the same rhythm.

Cadence is free to use.

Resonance turns your personal music files into a library that feels fast and familiar. Import tracks from files or folders and start listening in minutes. Keep full control of your collection without relying on cloud subscriptions.

Resonance is built for people who already own music and want a cleaner daily listening workflow on iPhone and iPad. You can bring in songs from share sheets, AirDrop, or the file picker, review metadata before import, and then play everything with responsive browsing and playback controls.

**Import Music Your Way**
Bring in single files or entire folders with support for common audio formats discovered by the app. The import flow expands folders, validates playable audio, and gives you clear feedback on what was added or skipped.

**Clean Metadata Before Saving**
Review title, artist, and album values before finalizing import so your library stays readable. You can edit one track or apply updates in bulk, then include or exclude items with simple toggles.

**Browse a Library That Stays Organized**
Jump through recently added tracks, artists, albums, playlists, and liked songs from one consistent structure. Resonance stores your music metadata locally, so browsing remains quick and available even without a network.

**Playlists and Favorites That Fit Your Day**
Create playlists in seconds, rename them later, and remove tracks when your mood changes. Mark favorites with the heart control and revisit them instantly in the dedicated liked songs view.

**Playback Controls With Real Flexibility**

Download Resonance and turn scattered audio files into a focused, personal listening space.

Your music. Your library. Your sound.

No account required. No cloud music library. Just your music.

• Connect up to 9 devices

Perfect for parties, rooms, trips, gatherings, and anywhere you want more sound without carrying a speaker system.

**One phone starts the music. Up to 8 more join the party.**

Play the music you already own and browse your collection by:

• Songs
• Albums
• Artists
• Genres
• Playlists
• Recently Added
• Recently Played

Search your library, sort songs, create playlists, mark favorites, and keep track of what you've been listening to.

### POWERFUL PLAYBACK

• Play, pause, seek, next and previous
• Shuffle and repeat
• Gapless playback
• Persistent playback queue
• Drag to reorder your queue
• Resume where you left off
• Background playback
• Lock Screen controls
• Headset and Bluetooth media controls
• Automatic pause when headphones are unplugged
• MP3, M4A/AAC, WAV and FLAC support

### SHAPE YOUR SOUND

Customize your listening experience with:

• 5-band equalizer
• Normal, Pop, Classic, Jazz and Rock presets
• Custom equalizer settings
• Bass Boost
• Surround Sound

### SLEEP TIMER

Choose exactly how long your music should play. A live countdown and gentle fade-out make it easy to listen before sleep.

### ORGANIZE YOUR MUSIC

• Create, rename and delete playlists
• Add, remove and reorder songs
• Favorite your songs
• Browse by artist, album and genre
• View recently added and recently played music

### EDIT YOUR MUSIC

Edit song title, artist, album, genre, year, disc number and track number. Choose your own artwork for songs and albums.

For supported formats, metadata edits can also be written back into the audio file.

### AUTOMATIC MUSIC IDENTIFICATION

Identify tracks with missing or incorrect information and retrieve title, artist, album, year and cover artwork.

**Available with Rewind Pro.**

### CAR & HOME SCREEN

• CarPlay integration
• Home Screen widgets
• Lock Screen widgets
• Now Playing integration
• Media playback controls

### LOCAL-FIRST & PRIVATE

Rewind Player does not require an account and does not maintain a cloud music library.

Your music stays on your device. Import music from Files or your own downloaded, DRM-free music collection for offline listening.

### REWIND PRO

Upgrade to Rewind Pro to remove advertising and unlock automatic music identification, metadata and cover-art lookup.

**Rewind Player**

Your music. Your library. Your sound.

items.title: Cadence: Tempo & BPM
items.subtitle: Music
items.tertiaryTitle:
Designed for iPhone.
Not verified for macOS.
items.productDescription:
Cadence is a music player built around one thing most players ignore: tempo.

Other speed-changer apps only let you nudge a song by a vague percentage. Cadence works in real beats per minute. Set a track to an exact BPM and see at a glance which songs already sit at the same speed — so you can line up a whole set at the pace you want. For anyone who dances, teaches, or practices to music, that's a different kind of control.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

- Work in real BPM, not percentages. Every track carries its actual tempo, so "128 BPM" tells you something useful and you can match songs by speed.

- Set the tempo your way. Tap along with the beat to set a song's original BPM, or let Cadence detect it automatically.

- Change speed on your own tracks with the pitch kept natural. Import local audio and slow it down to drill a tough passage, then bring it back up to tempo as you improve — no chipmunk vocals.

- Build playlists and sets. Group tracks for a class, a practice session, or a social, and sort by tempo to sequence songs by speed.

- Share a set. Send a playlist to another dancer and their Cadence imports it with every tempo — original and preferred — intact.

- Bring your own music. Add songs from your Apple Music library (an Apple Music subscription is required to play catalog tracks), or import audio files straight from your device.

WHO IT'S FOR

Teachers who need a song at exactly the right pace for a class. Dancers who want to practice below tempo before taking it up to speed. Anyone who's ever wondered whether two songs are actually danceable at the same rhythm.

Cadence is free to use.

Resonance turns your personal music files into a library that feels fast and familiar. Import tracks from files or folders and start listening in minutes. Keep full control of your collection without relying on cloud subscriptions.

Resonance is built for people who already own music and want a cleaner daily listening workflow on iPhone and iPad. You can bring in songs from share sheets, AirDrop, or the file picker, review metadata before import, and then play everything with responsive browsing and playback controls.

**Import Music Your Way**
Bring in single files or entire folders with support for common audio formats discovered by the app. The import flow expands folders, validates playable audio, and gives you clear feedback on what was added or skipped.

**Clean Metadata Before Saving**
Review title, artist, and album values before finalizing import so your library stays readable. You can edit one track or apply updates in bulk, then include or exclude items with simple toggles.

**Browse a Library That Stays Organized**
Jump through recently added tracks, artists, albums, playlists, and liked songs from one consistent structure. Resonance stores your music metadata locally, so browsing remains quick and available even without a network.

**Playlists and Favorites That Fit Your Day**
Create playlists in seconds, rename them later, and remove tracks when your mood changes. Mark favorites with the heart control and revisit them instantly in the dedicated liked songs view.

**Playback Controls With Real Flexibility**
Use mini and full player layouts with play, pause, seek, shuffle, repeat, and next/previous controls. Lock-screen media controls and background audio support keep your session moving while you use other apps.

Download Resonance and turn scattered audio files into a focused, personal listening space.

Your music. Your library. Your sound.

Rewind Player is a powerful music player for the music you already own, with a clean interface, powerful playback controls, customizable sound, and a unique way to share music across multiple nearby devices.

No account required. No cloud music library. Just your music.

• Connect up to 9 devices
• Discover nearby devices automatically
• Join using a short party code
• Control each device's volume independently
• Fine-tune individual device latency
• Automatically reconnect devices that drop out
• Keep music flowing continuously across track changes

Perfect for parties, rooms, trips, gatherings, and anywhere you want more sound without carrying a speaker system.

**One phone starts the music. Up to 8 more join the party.**

### YOUR MUSIC LIBRARY

Play the music you already own and browse your collection by:

• Songs
• Albums
• Artists
• Genres
• Playlists
• Recently Added
• Recently Played

Search your library, sort songs, create playlists, mark favorites, and keep track of what you've been listening to.

### POWERFUL PLAYBACK

• Play, pause, seek, next and previous
• Shuffle and repeat
• Gapless playback
• Persistent playback queue
• Drag to reorder your queue
• Resume where you left off
• Background playback
• Lock Screen controls
• Headset and Bluetooth media controls

### SHAPE YOUR SOUND

Customize your listening experience with:

• 5-band equalizer
• Normal, Pop, Classic, Jazz and Rock presets
• Custom equalizer settings
• Bass Boost

### SLEEP TIMER

Choose exactly how long your music should play. A live countdown and gentle fade-out make it easy to listen before sleep.

### ORGANIZE YOUR MUSIC

• Create, rename and delete playlists
• Add, remove and reorder songs
• Favorite your songs

### EDIT YOUR MUSIC

Edit song title, artist, album, genre, year, disc number and track number. Choose your own artwork for songs and albums.

### CAR & HOME SCREEN

• CarPlay integration
• Home Screen widgets
• Lock Screen widgets

• Media playback controls

### LOCAL-FIRST & PRIVATE

Rewind Player does not require an account and does not maintain a cloud music library.

Your music stays on your device. Import music from Files or your own downloaded, DRM-free music collection for offline listening.

### REWIND PRO

Upgrade to Rewind Pro to remove advertising and unlock automatic music identification, metadata and cover-art lookup.

**Rewind Player**

Your music. Your library. Your sound.
